entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to make a return. I bought this jersey a while ago, and I feel so bad, but I finally tried it on for a big ride and it's just... not right.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into that for you. To clarify, is there a technical fault with it, or is it more of a preference issue?

It's the size. It's the wrong size for me. It's just too tight across the shoulders, and I can't ride comfortably in it. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and this has never happened. I'm so disappointed.
I understand, getting the right fit is crucial for comfort. Let me see what we can do. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I really hope you can help. With the holidays, I was really counting on getting that money back.
Okay, thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the order for the Aero Pro jersey, delivered about 59 days ago. Just one moment while I check our return policy on that item.
Okay... I hope it's not too late.

Alright, I've got good news. That jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy, so you are well within the window. We can absolutely process that for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. A refund would be best for now, if that's okay. I really appreciate this.

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you a prepaid return label to your email on file right now. Just package the jersey back up, apply the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That's wonderful. You've been a great help. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
